flows.name: An organisation verifies an AI agent before and after it reaches production (VerifyAX)
flows.summary: As Conscium's home page describes VerifyAX: "Before an agent touches production, Verify ax tells you whether it does what you think it does." The page's reason: agents behave correctly in testing and incorrectly in production, drift over time and can be manipulated by malicious inputs.

steps.what: Brings an AI agent it plans to deploy to the VerifyAX platform.
Runs the agent through simulated environments to see how it behaves under a wide range of conditions.
steps.agent: The agent under test acts in the simulations as it would in production; that behaviour is what is measured.

steps.what: Tells the organisation whether the agent does what it thinks it does, before it touches production.
Deploys the agent, with the visibility and control to manage risk and meet compliance requirements.
Keeps testing, auditing and governing the agent after deployment, for the ways agents fail later (drift over time, manipulation by malicious inputs).
